features.name: strength_balance_norm
features.description: Signed normalized difference in animal strength; values above zero favor white and values below zero favor black.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a calibrated linear axis for side-to-side strength imbalance.

features.name: strength_total_norm
features.description: Normalized total animal strength across both pieces, using the observed 0 to 7 strength scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets the margin adjust for overall piece tier and broad endgame texture.

features.name: capture_rule_balance
features.description: Jungle capture hierarchy balance with the smallest-versus-largest exception; +1 means a one-way white capture edge, -1 means a one-way black capture edge, 0 means symmetric or equal hierarchy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a rule discontinuity that raw integer strength differences cannot represent linearly.

features.name: rat_elephant_exception_balance
features.description: Isolates the cyclic smallest/largest animal interaction: +1 for smallest white against largest black, -1 for largest white against smallest black, 0 otherwise.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a direct feature for a rare but important non-ordinal matchup.

features.name: piece_separation_manhattan_norm
features.description: Manhattan separation between pieces divided by the board maximum of 14.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth distance axis for encounter likelihood and tempo.

features.name: capture_proximity_balance
features.description: One-way capture hierarchy balance multiplied by proximity, so close threats have larger magnitude than remote threats.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a strength-position interaction usable by a linear SVM.
features.formula: (np.where((((white_piece0_strength > black_piece0_strength) & ((white_piece0_strength < 7) | (black_piece0_strength > 0))) | ((white_piece0_strength == 0) & (black_piece0_strength == 7))), 1.0, np.where((((black_piece0_strength > white_piece0_strength) & ((black_piece0_strength < 7) | (white_piece0_strength > 0))) | ((black_piece0_strength == 0) & (white_piece0_strength == 7))), -1.0, 0.0)) * (1.0 - ((np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_file - 1.0 * black_piece0_file) + np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_rank - 1.0 * black_piece0_rank)) / 14.0)))

features.name: same_line_pressure_score
features.description: Alignment pressure on a shared file or rank, decreasing linearly with separation along that line and zero off-line.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures row/column contact geometry not expressible by independent coordinates alone.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.where((white_piece0_file == black_piece0_file), 1.0 - (np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_rank - 1.0 * black_piece0_rank) / 8.0), 0.0), np.where((white_piece0_rank == black_piece0_rank), 1.0 - (np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_file - 1.0 * black_piece0_file) / 6.0), 0.0))

features.name: advance_balance_norm
features.description: Signed progress contrast using standard opposite-edge orientation: white progress toward high ranks versus black progress toward low ranks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a normalized territorial projection for the margin.

features.name: opposing_den_distance_balance_norm
features.description: Distance contrast to opposing dens at file 3, ranks 8 and 0; values above zero indicate white is closer to its attacking den than black is to its attacking den.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates race-to-den pressure with one side-to-side distance contrast.
features.formula: (((np.abs(1.0 * black_piece0_file - 3.0) + np.abs(1.0 * black_piece0_rank - 0.0)) - (np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_file - 3.0) + np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_rank - 8.0))) / 11.0)

features.name: mirror_symmetry_score
features.description: Score for equal-strength mirrored placement under reflection across the board center; 1 means perfectly mirrored and equal strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights symmetric configurations that may need a different margin offset than asymmetric configurations.
features.formula: (1.0 - (((np.abs(1.0 * white_piece0_strength - 1.0 * black_piece0_strength) / 7.0) + (np.abs((1.0 * white_piece0_file) - (6.0 - 1.0 * black_piece0_file)) / 6.0) + (np.abs((1.0 * white_piece0_rank) - (8.0 - 1.0 * black_piece0_rank)) / 8.0)) / 3.0))

features.name: trap_den_tactical_balance_judgment
features.description: Rules-aware scorer rates den/trap context from the six row fields and fixed Jungle board landmarks: +1 strongly favors white, -1 strongly favors black, 0 neutral.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects compact nonlinear trap and den semantics that coordinates alone do not expose to a linear margin.

features.name: river_movement_balance_judgment
features.description: Rules-aware scorer rates relative movement flexibility from piece strength and square, accounting for water access, river blocking, and leaping ability; +1 favors white mobility, -1 favors black mobility, 0 neutral.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes animal-specific movement constraints as a smooth side-to-side axis.
